scope: Local post-factory-reset adapter recovery and credential invalidation; remote reset commands unchanged

round_one.method: Trace actual entrypoints; reproduce counterexamples before fixing
reproduced_failures: Expired post-reset offer returned False without UI feedback
Fresh ambiguous inventory dropped proven original static recovery when a second adapter existed
fixes: Publish an explicit expiry/reconfirmation message without starting network work
Retain proven static migration only on the same id, MAC, addresses and static mode; do not guess another adapter

round_two.method: Independent reverse trace from UI/password reload, exception injection, then broader offline regression
fault_injection: Worker could not start or raised at startup
Deletion pending while login page is rebuilt

official_sources.checked: Per-instance DHCP renewal and native failure codes; revalidate live addresses rather than assuming success
Delete only specified TargetName and generic credential type; missing target is already absent
Thread affinity and queued delivery; existing completion broker owns GUI callbacks
Read current interface inventory, id, MAC and addresses; no mutation during inspection
Asynchronous process lifecycle and failure signals for existing credential helper
Existing renewal uses connection UUID plus explicit ifname; keep NetworkManager as owner

limitations: No real router reset or physical Wi-Fi-to-Ethernet retest
No mutation of real PC adapter or real saved router credentials
Linux branches mocked; native Debian 12 not validated
OpenWrt documentation page blocked by access protection; remote reset implementation was not changed
